scope: Event mechanics reference. Only stable mechanics with multiple-source support are described; dates, times, score values, thresholds and reward quantities remain omitted where sources conflict or live client verification is unavailable.
verificationPolicy: Event schedule and scoring are server-, season- and version-sensitive. Check the in-game event panel and alliance mail before acting.

events.name: Alliance Duel / Alliance Versus
events.frequency: recurring weekly; server schedule requires verification
events.objective: Coordinate alliance members around the active daily progression theme and maximize eligible contribution.
mechanics: A multi-day alliance competition with daily task themes.
The eligible actions and scoring list must be read from the live event panel; theme labels alone do not guarantee an action scores.
preparation: Hold relevant upgrade items until the matching live task is active.
Coordinate resource timing with Full Preparedness only after checking both task lists.
Do not rely on old point tables or assumed daily themes.
events.verification: Theme structure described by multiple community sources; exact day order and scoring need in-game check.
events.participation: Check cycle eligibility and the current daily task tabs. Registration, server age and alliance participation may vary; follow live instructions.
events.f2pStrategy: Choose free tasks and attainable personal/alliance chests. Hold badges, hero items, construction and training resources until the current task confirms they score.
events.spendingStrategy: Do not chase an alliance rank unless leadership agrees and the reward justifies badge, speedup and troop opportunity costs.
commonMistakes: Assuming last week's weekday mapping is universal.
Treating a theme label as proof every related action scores.
Spending before checking the live points panel.

events.name: Full Preparedness
events.objective: Complete the active short-window progression tasks to earn event chests.
mechanics: Community references describe six rotations of four hours each, covering the full day.
Five broad progression themes are reported.
Some windows can overlap with Alliance Duel themes, allowing one action to contribute to both systems when both task lists include it.
preparation: Check the current rotation and task list before claiming or spending.
Prepare eligible upgrades in advance where the game permits completion to be held.
Do not assume the Full Preparedness task list is identical to the Alliance Duel list.
events.rewards: Chest rewards vary by active task and are not reproduced without current in-game evidence.

serverSchedule.status: community-cross-checked; user server offset needs verification

events.verification: Six four-hour rotations agree across two current community references. Exact theme mapping and local clock conversion require screenshot.
events.participation: Check active rotation, theme, countdown and server time. Community references describe six four-hour windows, but confirm current edition and Apocalypse Time in-game.
events.f2pStrategy: Prepare free or already-planned upgrades for a matching task. Aim for attainable chests. Check both event task lists before assuming overlap.
events.spendingStrategy: Spend only when a verified threshold is worth more than the account opportunity cost.
commonMistakes: Assuming the Alliance Duel and Full Preparedness lists match.
Using an unverified Apocalypse Time conversion.
Spending after a task window changes.

events.name: Canyon Clash
events.frequency: reported recurring weekly; confirm event center
events.objective: Win alliance points by coordinating movement and control of strategic battlefield objectives.
mechanics: Community descriptions agree on a staged process involving time selection, registration, opponent matching and a battle.
Battle points are tied to objective control and battlefield actions.
Two commanders and group coordination are described in one guide.
preparation: Confirm registered starters and substitutes with R4/R5.
Agree on objective groups, commander calls and teleport timing before battle.
Capture the event's live rules screen because participant caps and battle length conflict between sources.
conflicts: One source reports up to 20 main players plus 30 substitutes and a 45-minute battle; another reports 20 starters plus 10 substitutes and a 40-minute battle plus preparation/settlement.
Eligibility and registration limits differ; do not publish numeric limits yet.
events.verification: Core staged format and objective-based alliance scoring are supported; exact participant limits, timing and point values need in-game verification.
events.participation: Check current registration for eligibility, starters, substitutes, commanders and battle time. Sources disagree on substitute slots and battle length; no universal cap is stated.
events.f2pStrategy: Ask leadership which objective or support role is needed before spending teleports or healing.
events.spendingStrategy: Commit teleports, healing or buffs only after confirming live rules and alliance plan.
commonMistakes: Assuming old participant limits or battle duration.
Teleporting without an objective or return plan.
Ignoring substitute and commander assignments.

events.name: Battle for the Capital
events.objective: Compete for capital occupation and control.
mechanics: Community reference describes occupation progress as the central win condition.
The winning alliance leadership may receive authority to appoint a President for the war zone.
preparation: Coordinate alliance entry, reinforcement and defense plans.
Confirm the live occupation rules, time limit and appointment privileges for the current event edition.
events.verification: Core occupation objective is described by event reference; details and reward package require current panel.
events.participation: Check server notice for registration, war-zone eligibility, time, teleport limits and occupation rules.
events.f2pStrategy: Follow alliance occupation/defense plan and reinforce assigned players.
events.spendingStrategy: Coordinate paid teleports, shields and healing with alliance leadership and live conditions.
commonMistakes: Using another server's schedule.
Assuming occupation or appointment rules are unchanged.
Fighting away from assigned objectives.

events.name: Server War (SvS)
events.objective: Compete across paired servers through preparation and capital battle phases.
mechanics: Community sources describe a preparation/scoring phase followed by a capital battle phase.
Preparation activities and attacker/defender assignment are server-event dependent.
preparation: Follow the paired-server event panel and server leadership plan.
Do not assume last season's scoring, battle day or teleport rules apply.
events.verification: Two-phase concept is reported; dates, scoring sources and victory conditions require in-game confirmation.
events.participation: Use paired-server panel for eligibility, preparation and battle phases, teleport rules and assignments. Schedule is server/season-dependent.
events.f2pStrategy: Complete free preparation tasks aligned with normal development and follow leadership in battle.
events.spendingStrategy: Agree priorities with leadership before committing speedups, healing, shields or teleports.
commonMistakes: Assuming old pairing or battle dates apply.
Spending without checking scoring categories.
Ignoring server-wide protection and battle plans.

events.name: Zombie Tyrant
events.objective: Coordinate rallies to deal damage to an alliance boss.
mechanics: An R4/R5 scheduled activity is described by the event reference.
Rewards are described as combining alliance damage and individual contribution.
preparation: Ask R4/R5 for the current start time and rally plan.
Have troops and march buffs ready before the scheduled window.
Use alliance instructions for rally point placement and damage coordination.
events.rewards: Collective and personal reward tracks are described; exact thresholds and quantities withheld.
events.verification: Rally and combined contribution structure supported by event guide; duration, member threshold and MVP multiplier need in-game evidence.
events.participation: Confirm alliance schedule, eligibility and rally instructions with R4/R5. Exact member thresholds and timing need the event panel.
events.f2pStrategy: Join announced rallies with a suitable march; avoid premium buffs unless the event or leadership plan confirms value.
events.spendingStrategy: Coordinate buffs and attempts after checking damage and reward rules; do not assume MVP multipliers.
commonMistakes: Arriving late or using the wrong march.
Assuming reward thresholds are unchanged.
Changing rally placement without leadership.

events.name: Shooting Loot
events.objective: Exchange event ammunition/shots for prize draws.
mechanics: Event-specific currency and prize selection are reported.
preparation: Check currency carry-over, free attempts, prize pool and guarantee rules in the live event panel before spending.
events.verification: Basic event concept only; shot guarantees, currency carry-over and milestone rewards unverified.
events.participation: Read live rules to confirm shot sources, prize pools, free attempts, guarantees and carry-over.
events.f2pStrategy: Complete available tasks first. Save currency only when the current rules explicitly confirm carry-over.
events.spendingStrategy: Compare guaranteed milestones with actual purchase cost; do not rely on old rewards.
commonMistakes: Assuming shot currency carries over.
Buying before checking guarantees.
Confusing random draws with milestones.

events.name: Bullseye Booty

mechanics: Detailed mechanics not sufficiently corroborated in current research.
preparation: Read current event rules, currency sources and prize path before spending.
events.participation: Reviewed sources do not establish a universal rule. Check live eligibility, entry currency, free attempts and reward track.
events.f2pStrategy: Use free attempts and tasks shown in the event. Keep premium currency until guarantees and probabilities are clear.
events.spendingStrategy: Do not buy currency until current probability, guarantee, milestone and carry-over are confirmed.

Spending before checking probabilities.
Treating an informal name as an official mode.

events.verification: Not enough corroborated current detail for a mechanics guide.
